What to check in the PDF
  1. Merged header cells (colspan and rowspan) in Table 1 line up with the data columns under them.
  2. The landscape section turns the page sideways and the wide 18-column table fits without clipping.
  3. Pages after the landscape section return to portrait.
  4. Heat-map cell colors print (shades of maroon). Badges keep their rounded colored background.
  5. The two-column newspaper text flows down column 1, then column 2, and continues correctly onto the next page.
  6. SVG charts are sharp (zoom in: lines should not blur) and are not split across pages.
  7. The long URL wraps inside its box instead of running off the page.
  8. The table nested inside a table cell renders with its own borders.
  9. The embedded image (a small generated PNG) appears.
